headline: Gratitude Day—pausing to appreciate the abundance in your life
universal_truth: Gratitude transforms what you have into enough; it's the foundation of contentment
fun_facts: Regular gratitude practice improves sleep, reduces pain, and boosts immunity
Expressing gratitude to others strengthens relationships more than receiving it
The brain can't hold gratitude and anxiety simultaneously
discussion_questions: What are you most grateful for today?
Who in your life deserves more appreciation?
What do you take for granted that's actually remarkable?

hook.script: Today we pause to appreciate. Not because things are perfect—they never are—but because gratitude finds abundance in the midst of imperfection. Let's practice noticing what's good.

cliff.script: Gratitude can feel forced or fake. What makes it genuine and powerful?

options.text: Specific and felt—generic gratitude is hollow; naming specific gifts and letting yourself feel appreciation makes it genuine and transformative
options.response: Yes. Not 'grateful for family' but 'grateful my sister called when I was struggling.' Specific gratitude connects to real feeling. That's where the power is.
Saying it helps, but feeling it transforms. The words are a doorway to the experience...

fact1.title: People Who Helped
fact1.script: Think of someone who made your life better—recently or long ago. A teacher, friend, stranger. Let yourself feel genuine appreciation for their impact on your life.

fact2.title: Simple Gifts
fact2.script: Consider the simple things: running water, a warm bed, the ability to read this. Billions throughout history lacked what you might overlook. Let wonder return to the ordinary.

fact3.title: Expressing It
fact3.script: Felt gratitude becomes more powerful when expressed. Today, tell someone what you appreciate about them. Write a note. Make a call. Expressed gratitude multiplies.

wisdom.script: Here's the wisdom of gratitude: It doesn't change what you have—it changes how you experience what you have. That shift changes everything.

outro.script: Carry this gratitude with you today. Let it color how you see the world. And express it to at least one person. Happy Gratitude Day.

growTrack.title: Gratitude Expression - Say It Out Loud
growTrack.activity: Write down 10 things you're grateful for—be specific. Then choose one person to thank today. Send them a message, call them, or tell them in person. Notice how expressing gratitude feels.
